items.text: NBC News, Al Jazeera, NPR (June 14-15): The known deal terms as announced publicly include: (1) All warfare ends immediately and permanently on all fronts, including Lebanon — per Iran's Supreme National Security Council. (2) US naval blockade on Iran ends immediately and completely. (3) Strait of Hormuz opens toll-free (Trump: 'fully authorize the toll free opening'). (4) Deal includes provisions for dismantling Iran's nuclear programme, along with economic incentives if Tehran meets its commitments — per TradingEconomics/NPR. (5) A broader deal covering sanctions relief for Iran to be negotiated during a 60-day ceasefire period. (6) 'Pre-implementation discussions' underway (Pakistan PM's phrase) — this includes mine-removal coordination, shipping corridor clearance, and verification. Iran Deputy FM Gharibabadi said Iran sees this as a 'victory' and that the text will be released following the Switzerland signing ceremony. The nuclear ambiguity persists: Iran publicly says the MOU doesn't address nuclear; CBS sources say a 15-20 year lockout + dismantlement is in the text. The true nuclear terms will only become clear when the full text is released after Friday's Switzerland ceremony.

items.text: NBC News live, Al Jazeera (June 15): Despite the deal being announced, Israel immediately signalled it would not honour the Lebanon clause. Israeli military sources said Israeli forces will not withdraw from Lebanese territory. Israel's Defence Minister Katz had previously stated the same. Iran FM Araghchi warned that Israeli attacks in Lebanon 'need to be stopped' — a condition Iran attached to the broader deal. The deal, as announced by Iran's SNSC, includes 'an immediate and permanent end to warfare on all fronts, including Lebanon' — but Israel, which is not a party to this US-Iran MOU, has explicitly refused to withdraw. This is the single most important structural risk to the deal's durability: if Israel continues strikes in Lebanon, Iran's hawks will argue the deal was broken by the other side and push for Hormuz re-closure. Trump, who rebuked Netanyahu last week ('doesn't call the shots'), would need to apply significant pressure on Israel to hold the Lebanon clause. The G7 (Evian-les-Bains, Jun 15-17) is the diplomatic arena where this is being played out.

military.t: THE WAR IS EFFECTIVELY OVER — Deal Announced Sunday Jun 14. Trump: 'Hormuz OPEN TO ALL. Let the oil flow!' Iran SNSC: warfare ends immediately on all fronts. Formal signing Friday Jun 19 Switzerland. Mine removal: pre-implementation underway.
military.d: NPR, NBC News, NewsNation, Al Jazeera (June 14-15): After 108 days of conflict that killed over 7,000 people, spiked global oil to $111/barrel, shut the Strait of Hormuz, and cost the global economy an estimated $1-2 trillion, the war is effectively over. Trump announced Sunday June 14: 'The Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete. Congratulations to all! I hereby fully authorize the toll free opening of the Strait of Hormuz, and simultaneously herewith, authorize the immediate removal of the United States Naval blockade.' Iran's Supreme National Security Council confirmed all warfare 'will end immediately and permanently from tonight' and the naval blockade 'will end immediately and completely.' Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif confirmed: 'Peace Deal between US and Islamic Republic of Iran has been REACHED.' Iran Deputy FM Gharibabadi confirmed and called it a 'victory for Iran.' Trump Monday at G7 Evian-les-Bains with Macron: 'The deal's all signed.' Formal signing ceremony: Friday June 19 in Switzerland. Pre-implementation discussions (mine removal, shipping corridor clearing, verification) underway. Deal terms: warfare ends on all fronts (incl. Lebanon) + blockade ends + Hormuz toll-free + nuclear programme to be dismantled + 60-day broader deal negotiation window.

military.t: DEAL TERMS: Warfare ends on ALL FRONTS including Lebanon + Blockade ends + Hormuz Toll-free + Nuclear Dismantlement + 60-day Broader Sanctions/Reconstruction Window. Iran says deal is 'Victory.' Nuclear ambiguity: Iran public vs CBS sources.
military.d: NPR, NBC News, TradingEconomics, Al Jazeera (June 14-15): The publicly confirmed terms of the US-Iran deal (Islamabad MOU, formal name): (1) All warfare ends immediately and permanently on all fronts — specifically including Lebanon (per Iran's Supreme National Security Council via Tasnim). (2) US naval blockade on Iranian ports ends immediately and completely. (3) Strait of Hormuz reopens toll-free (Trump authorised this explicitly). (4) Deal includes provisions for dismantling Iran's nuclear programme, along with economic incentives if Tehran meets commitments. (5) A broader deal covering sanctions relief, reconstruction funding, and final peace terms to be negotiated in a 60-day ceasefire period. (6) Pre-implementation discussions: mine removal from Hormuz, shipping corridor clearance, and verification of ceasefire compliance. NUCLEAR AMBIGUITY: Iran's FM spokesperson publicly stated the MOU does not address nuclear issues. CBS News sources, however, say the MOU commits Iran to a 15-20 year enrichment lockout with dismantlement of nuclear sites. The full text will be released at the Switzerland ceremony on Friday June 19 — that is when the nuclear terms (and all other terms) will become definitively clear. Iran's Deputy FM Gharibabadi called the deal a 'victory for Iran' and indicated Iran received significant concessions (implied: economic incentives, sanctions pathway).

military.t: ISRAEL-LEBANON: Forces WON'T Withdraw. Iran FM Warned Attacks 'Need to Stop.' The One Remaining Structural Risk to Deal Durability. G7 (Jun 15-17): Trump Pressure on Netanyahu Central to Deal Sustainability.
military.d: NBC News live, Al Jazeera (June 15): Despite the deal announcement, Israel immediately indicated it would not comply with the 'all fronts including Lebanon' clause. Israeli forces will not withdraw from Lebanese territory — a position stated by Israel's Defence Minister Katz both before and after the deal. Iran's FM Araghchi warned at G7 (Evian-les-Bains) that Israeli attacks in Lebanon 'need to stop,' signalling that Iran's SNSC ceasefire declaration is conditional on Israel honouring the Lebanon clause. This is the single most important risk to deal sustainability: if Israel continues military operations in Lebanon, Iran's hardliners will argue the deal was violated by the other side — creating pressure for Hormuz re-closure or renewed missile exchanges. Trump at G7 is applying pressure on Netanyahu ('doesn't call the shots') — the US needs Israel to at least nominally honour the Lebanon clause for the 60-day ceasefire period and allow the formal Friday Switzerland signing to proceed without crisis. The coming 72 hours (Tuesday-Thursday) are critical: any Israeli strike in Lebanon could destabilise the deal before the ink is formally dry.

assessment.body:
Tuesday 7:00 AM IST. Day 108. The war is effectively over.

THE DEAL — WHAT HAPPENED
Sunday June 14 evening IST (Day 106):
Pakistan PM Shehbaz: 'Peace Deal has been REACHED.'
Trump Truth Social: 'The Deal is now complete. Let the oil flow!'
'I hereby fully authorize the toll free opening of the Strait of Hormuz.'
'I simultaneously herewith authorize the immediate removal of the naval blockade.'
Iran Supreme National Security Council: warfare ends 'immediately and permanently.'
Iran Deputy FM: deal is a 'victory for Iran.'
Trump Monday at G7 with Macron: 'The deal's all signed.'
Formal signing ceremony: Friday June 19, Switzerland.

THE TERMS (confirmed publicly)
All warfare ends immediately on all fronts — INCLUDING LEBANON.
US naval blockade ends immediately and completely.
Strait of Hormuz reopens toll-free.
Iran's nuclear programme to be dismantled (nuclear ambiguity remains on specifics).
60-day window for broader sanctions / reconstruction deal.
Pre-implementation discussions: mine removal, shipping corridors, verification.

MARKETS — TWO-DAY WAR-END RALLY
Friday Jun 12: Nifty +461 pts (+1.99%), Sensex +1,695 pts (+2.3%).
Monday Jun 15: Nifty +231 pts (+0.98%), Sensex +736 pts (+0.97%).
TWO-DAY TOTAL: Nifty +692 pts, Sensex +2,432 pts.
Rupee +40 paise Monday (strongest single-session gain of the war).
Brent: $83.82 Monday close (-5%). WTI near $80.
India VIX: ~12-14 (lowest since the war began February 28).
Nikkei +5.42% Monday. Asia soared.
Realty, OMCs, Aviation, Paints, Tyres, Auto all surged.

THE ONE REMAINING RISK — ISRAEL-LEBANON
The deal says warfare ends on all fronts including Lebanon.
Israel says its forces will NOT withdraw from Lebanon.
Iran FM Araghchi: Israeli attacks in Lebanon 'need to stop.'
This is not resolved. If Israel strikes Lebanon before Friday's signing:
the deal's 'all fronts' clause is broken before the ink is dry.
Trump needs to hold Netanyahu back for 72 hours.

FOR INDIA
Biggest macroeconomic tailwind in 3 years.
Brent $83.82: petrol cut of Rs2-4/L likely in 2-3 weeks.
LPG cut from Rs941.50 likely in 4-6 weeks.
Rupee heading to Rs93-94/USD.
Current account deficit: narrowing significantly.
FII inflows: $2-4 billion expected first week post-signing.
18,000+ Indian seafarers in Gulf: repatriation window open.
Modi-Trump G7 bilateral: Settebello (3 Indian deaths) — India's one
remaining grievance in an otherwise dramatically improved bilateral.
The deal is the best possible outcome for India from the 108-day war.
The question now is only: how fast does the normalisation happen?
